dispute_note: CBA reversed the decision and said the announcement had been made in "error". The roles had been attributed to a new AI chat platform at the time of announcement.
notes: Must not be counted as realised AI displacement. The attribution was withdrawn by the employer itself.

dispute_note: The Finance Sector Union alleges some of these positions were subsequently advertised through Commonwealth Bank's India-based subsidiary, which would make them offshoring rather than automation.
notes: Announced amid CBA's AI push. The offshoring allegation is unresolved, so the AI attribution is contested rather than established.

Reported as hundreds of roles at CBA's outsourcing contractor in Johannesburg. Not Australian employment, and recorded separately so Australian and offshore losses are never conflated. Headcount left blank because no precise figure was published.

Included deliberately as a NEGATIVE case. Telstra cut more than 1,000 roles in the second half of 2025 and a spokesperson stated the company is "not proposing that any roles be replaced by AI as part of these changes". Recording denials is what stops this register becoming a list of every layoff relabelled as automation.
